shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
command -v lore_get_ci_failures || true
git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,120p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "Fix conversation list lint findings" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
